name: agenticbase
description: Claude Code plugins by DaMacDev: a usage-meter mod and a set of safety hooks.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Live gauges above the prompt for context fill, the 5-hour and weekly plan limits (with pace and reset time), plus zero-token /clear vs /compact hints.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Four safety hooks: block destructive shell commands, hardcoded secrets and permission-bypass flags, and check WebFetch URLs against an allowlist.
